title: How your favorite clothes get used
description: A history of confirmed wear shows what is used often and what was long forgotten.

blocks.text: A complex report quickly loses its point if the logging is hard to keep up.

quote.text: I started tracking my outfits 700 days ago on Stylebook and haven't missed a day! I find it extremely helpful to have data about what I am wearing and how often, especially the cost-per-wear information.

blocks.text: Allow yesterday’s outfit to be repeated and the date and contents to be corrected. Calculate the figures only from the data entered, showing where the history is incomplete.
Cost per wear is an estimate from the user’s own records, not an objective value for an item.
